bug_history.bug: SIGN BUG in the augmented system's hexagon target (root cause of the '54/54 solvable but direct_verify=false' anomaly; found, diagnosed, and fixed this session)
bug_history.detail: The correct condition for R_i(m,f.w) to land in K3 is Phi3(R_i)=r_i+A_i.xi=0, so A_i.xi must equal -r_i, not +r_i. The code solved A_i.xi=+r_i (predicted1=r_i+A_i.xi then equalled r_i+r_i=2*r_i=-r_i mod3, i.e. never zero unless r_i=0). Invisible under GF(2) since -r=r there. The order3/positive-control SURVIVES-K3 rows were immune because their baseline r_i was already exactly 0 (witness_support=0 for the bare candidate). Fixed via target:=Concatenation(-r1coeffs,-r2coeffs) (charming rows already correctly used -a(f),-b(f)). Confirmed via (1) analytic derivation, (2) minimal-counterexample export showing predicted=actual=2*r_i exactly for the pre-fix run, (3) a gamma-canary (gamma(A1.n_j)=+gamma(n_j), gamma(A2.n_j)=-gamma(n_j) for ALL basis n_j) passing with 0 fails/196 (window1) and 0 fails/100 (window2) at every m' tested post-fix, (4) all 18 previously-DIES candidates cleanly reversing to SOLVABLE+legal+charming+direct_verify=true immediately (no m'-sweep needed beyond the base m).
